name: lying-alternate-floor-leg-raise.html
instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with arms at your sides and legs straight. You can also put your hands underneath your lower back for support.
2. Engage your core and press your lower back into the floor. This is the starting position.
3. Slowly lift one leg off the ground until it's about 45–60 degrees from the floor (or as high as flexibility allows). Keep the other leg extended and relaxed on the floor.
4. Lower the working leg slowly. This is one rep.
5. Repeat on the alternate leg.
6. Perform desired reps.
